Theorem
[Compact Type I classification] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iii:page-0115 1. ch19:19.37\group Spherical Construction

Any compact Type I ancient solution with positive curvature operator which is $\kappa $-noncollapsed is a shrinking spherical space form.
